title: Electric Airplane Maker Beta Sees UP to $50M Revenue in FY26
summary: Beta Technologies has not certified any of the electric aircraft it is developing at its facilities in Vermont. Yet the manufacturer expects to generate up to $50 million in revenue in fiscal year 2026.
